concepts.def: Guest workers recruited from Turkey, Italy, Yugoslavia from the 1950s under bilateral agreements.
Merkel's 2015 declaration during the refugee crisis when Germany took in over 1 million asylum seekers.
Asylum — right enshrined in Article 16a of the Grundgesetz.
Integration — covers language courses, employment, civic education.
Used for counterfactuals: 'wäre/hätte + Partizip': 'ich hätte geholfen'.
Used after wegen, trotz, während: 'wegen der Migration'.
